scope: Theorem 2.2 (Tower obstruction) of the manuscript “A Counterexample to Wall's D(2) Problem” (preprints/A-Counterexample-to-Walls-D2-Problem-October-6-2026/wall-d2-counterexample.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 321 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 e34de3716e64bba4), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 4. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Let Y be a finite connected CW complex of dimension at most two, and let L be a rank-one complex local system on Y with H2(Y ; L) = 0. There is no map f : F → Y from a finite connected simplicial complex satisfying b1(F; Q) = 0 for which f∗L has nontrivial monodromy.
